features.text: Open patella design reduces kneecap pressure while maintaining stability
Premium neoprene material delivers therapeutic warmth and consistent compression
Enhanced padding system provides extra cushioning for sensitive areas
Moisture-wicking properties keep you comfortable during extended wear
Professional-grade support perfect for both activity and recovery

measurement: For optimal compression and support, measure the circumference of your knee at the center of the patella. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for detailed sizing guidance and expert fitting assistance.
